history.content: hey. i dont really know why im opening this. just kind of a rough night i guess
Hey — rough nights can be strangely enough reason on their own. What’s making it feel rough, if anything stands out?
its my dad. we had this thing planned for weeks. my birthday dinner. just me and him for once. he cancelled like an hour before. again
That sounds really let down — especially because it was meant to be just you and him, and it happened again. Is this more like disappointment, hurt, or both?
both i think. but mostly hurt. like he always finds time for my sister and her kids. work emergency he said. theres always a work emergency when its me

That hurts in a really specific way — like the cancellation isn’t just about tonight, but about being made to feel lower on the list. Does it feel more like a tight, aching hurt, or more like wanting to pull back and go quiet?
the second one. like i just texted back 'no worries' and now i dont even wanna pick up if he calls. ive stopped expecting anything from him honestly. its easier that way maybe
That sounds like pulling back to protect the part that keeps getting disappointed. Would you want to stay with that, or leave it here for now?
yeah. protecting myself i guess. i dont even know if its fair to him but i cant keep being the one who gets let down. i think im just tired of hoping he'll show up
Yeah — that sounds like protecting yourself from hoping and getting let down again. Do you want to stay with what that protective part is asking for, or let it rest here?
let it rest i think. im wiped. thanks for listening though. genuinely. helped to just say it out loud to something
Of course — I’m glad you said it out loud here. It can rest here, and I’ll keep hold of it quietly.
